parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the `PlaybackTests` test target under `Shared/Playback/Tests/`. Although the pipeline reports a Jaccard similarity of ~0.71, the two methods — `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multiplePlayCallsAreIdempotent` and `RouteChangeBehaviorTests.overrideWhilePlayingIsHandled` — belong to distinct test classes exercising distinct behavioral scenarios (idempotent play calls vs. route-change override handling). Structural similarity in test bodies is common when tests share setup/teardown boilerplate or assertion patterns, and collapsing them would obscure the distinct intent of each behavioral test suite. No production code is involved, so there is no duplication risk in the shipped artifact.
